requirement.title: Professional Graphics/Video settings with visual-economy presets
requirement.origin: Owner-directed P1C01 production requirement for a professional scalable Graphics/Video system without weakening the target-laptop floor.
requirement.intent: Provide a visually strong default Graphics/Video experience plus scalable higher-quality presets and Custom controls while preserving the Windows DX11 1280x720 Low-Medium 30 FPS floor on the i7 Gen6 / 8 GB RAM / ~2 GB VRAM target and making visible beauty per measured cost the permanent tuning rule.
implementation_refs: Docs/WORLD_DETAIL_LEDGER.md — P1C01 Graphics/Video Visual-Economy Doctrine V2
missing_work: Register this requirement and DEC-079 in Data/ProjectGovernor.json.
Implement the P1C01-only UGameUserSettings-backed runtime settings layer in the existing Public/Private C++ architecture.
Add Performance, CinematicBalanced, High, Ultra and Custom behavior without raising existing lower-tier scalability anchors.
Implement reversible resolution/window-mode/VSync/frame-cap/render-scale preview -> confirm -> revert behavior.
Synchronize Data/SourceArchitecturePlan.json, Docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md and Docs/PRODUCTION_COMPLETENESS_MATRIX.md in the same real-code increment.
Obtain exact-head UE4 compile/static proof, then focused PIE/device/performance/human visual acceptance before promotion.
acceptance_criteria: CinematicBalanced is the visually strong default direction while Performance preserves the target-laptop safety floor.
The 1280x720 DX11 Low-Medium 30 FPS target remains explicit and is not weakened by higher-quality presets.

Existing lower-tier anchors remain 600/800/1000 MB texture pools, 512/768/1024 shadow max resolution, 1/2/2 cascades, 0.45/0.65/0.80 shadow-distance and view-distance scales, and foliage tier 2 density 0.70 unless later measured evidence authorizes a change.
Display changes are reversible through preview, confirm and revert while preserving the first pre-preview snapshot.
Custom exposes bounded control over resolution, window mode, VSync, frame-rate limit, render scale and supported scalability groups.

Optimization recovers cost first from duplicate actors, far shadows, overdraw, translucency, redundant lights, uninstanced repetition, unnecessary Tick and invisible/far detail before degrading silhouette, composition, hero materials, lighting, atmosphere, landmark framing, readable characters or near-field detail.
No compile, PIE, device, visual or performance status is claimed without exact evidence.

decision.title: P1C01 Graphics/Video settings use a permanent visual-economy preset architecture
decision.resolution: Build the professional Graphics/Video settings system only inside the active P1C01 runtime lane. Use CinematicBalanced as the visually strong default direction, Performance as the target-laptop safety preset, High and Ultra as opt-in higher-quality presets, and Custom for bounded user control. Preserve the existing lower-tier anchors until measured evidence supports a change.
implementation_contract: Runtime scope remains W01_P1C01_PRODUCTION_VERTICAL_SLICE only; do not open later runtime chapters before Gate 6/7.
Target floor remains Windows DX11 at 1280x720 Low-Medium with a 30 FPS target on i7 Gen6 / 8 GB RAM / approximately 2 GB VRAM.
Preset family is Performance, CinematicBalanced, High, Ultra and Custom.

Existing lower-tier anchors remain texture pools 600/800/1000 MB; shadow max resolution 512/768/1024; shadow cascades 1/2/2; shadow-distance scale 0.45/0.65/0.80; view-distance scale 0.45/0.65/0.80; foliage tier 2 density 0.70.
Supported display controls include resolution, window mode, VSync, frame-rate limit and render scale.
Display changes use preview -> confirm -> revert and preserve the first snapshot across repeated previews.
Protect silhouette, composition, hero materials, lighting, atmosphere, landmark framing, readable characters and near-field detail.
Recover cost first from duplicate actors, far shadows, overdraw, translucency, redundant lights, uninstanced repetition, unnecessary Tick and invisible/far detail.

Heavy assets continue to use soft references plus async FStreamableManager loading; repeated decoration uses ISM/HISM with LOD/culling; crowds remain pooled; animated final assets remain FBX and production textures PNG/TGA/channel-packed.
Real code changes must update Data/SourceArchitecturePlan.json, Docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md and Docs/PRODUCTION_COMPLETENESS_MATRIX.md in the same increment.
No runtime implementation may be labeled compile-, PIE-, device-, visual- or performance-validated without exact-head evidence.

apply_rule: Fail closed unless the Governor blob is still the observed SHA and both IDs remain absent. After Governor commit, update the V11 preparation authority_state and only then open runtime settings source.
